description: Publish an HTML file as a NEW live link and return its URL. Use update_page to change an existing page instead.

access.description: public: anyone with the link (only when the user says so). email: only `emails` (Builder plan). private: only the owner.

emails.description: Who can open an email page; each is emailed an invitation with an access link. Only with access "email".

expires.description: Delete the page after 30m, 12h, 7d, 2w, or on a date like 2026-12-31.

html.description: The page as an HTML string (up to 5 MB), instead of `path`. Cannot carry local images or videos.

invite.description: Email page only: false publishes without emailing the invitations (send them later with invite_recipients). Default true.

path.description: Path to the .html or .htm file (absolute, or relative to where the server runs). Its local images and videos are uploaded too.

name: publish_page
title: Publish a page
